description.text: Core courses Introduction to Linguistics, Introduction to Teaching Chinese as a Second Language, Introduction to Chinese Culture, Modern Chinese, Ancient Chinese, English, Modern and Contemporary Chinese Literature, Ancient Chinese Literature, Foreign Literature, Introduction to European and American Culture Objective This objective is to train students to obtain the theory, knowledge and ability of Chinese language and culture, and have a good command of English language so that students, after graduation, are able to work at home and abroad teaching Chinese as a second language, or serve as professional applied-oriented personnel in the field of cultural exchanges with overseas countries. This undergraduate major falls into three aspects: literature, culture and language. Literature includes Chinese and foreign literature; culture includes Chinese and foreign culture; language includes Chinese and English. In addition, students are required to grasp the knowledge of the branches of linguistics Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 175 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Arts is granted

duration.text: The Teaching Chinese as A Second Language at Sichuan Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Certification of no criminal record 8.Copy of insurance policy 9.Photocopies of personal artwork Those who apply for artistic major should supply materials to prove your art level.

requirements.text: 1.High school graduates 2.No criminal record 3.HSK level 3 or above
